content.short: MetaCartel funds and supports individuals and teams building toward the Web3 vision.
content.description: MetaCartel serves as a central hub for Web3, supporting early dApps and crypto experiments. It funds and backs individuals and teams who contribute to this vision, acting as the community's coordinating body, connectors, and fabric. By coordinating projects, sharing resources, and fostering collaboration, MetaCartel aims to accelerate the widespread adoption of Web3 and the open internet of value, with the goal of making the world richer and fairer for all.
content.meta: MetaCartel is a DAO that funds and supports teams building toward the Web3 vision. Discover MetaCartel and other DAOs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
